column1: # Game profile of Xenoblade Chronicles 3 (Switch, base game v0 = 1.0.0). Boots into the field and battles on an iPhone; rendering not finished (docs/xenoblade3.md)
# Monolith Soft's engine on SDK 12.3.9, NVN 55. Every file lives in one archive, bf3.ard, indexed by bf3.arh; started from the provisional profile scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py wrote from its
# survey (dm/games/profile_guess.py). The game has no American English (control data languages 0x70de): pack with a language it has, e.g. --language zh-Hans
# The game reserves a 60 GB virtual address region for its own allocator; patches.py cuts it to 4 GB (0.75 GB small-object arena, then large-block chunks) and dm/tools/sdk_patches.py cuts
# the SDK's node area to 62 MB and the region's 1 GB alignment to 32 MB, so the region starts at alias +64 MB, followed by the 64 MB reserve region. The large-block allocator
# never returns addresses to its region: once the region is used up, the host grows it over extra address regions above it (dm/host/hle_monolib_alloc.c), 512 MB each,
# so the alias region is 4.875 GB (a 5.5 GB reservation; one block of 6 GB was proven on a phone, 7 GB fails)
# SPCH packs in bf3.ard's entries (global /monolib/shader/*.wishp, each map's .wismda, the models' .wismt streams), GLSLC outputs in /effect/cmn_assets.wipac, NVSD containers and GLSLC outputs
# in main (shader_split.py arh_jobs, nvsd_shaders); 55 shaders the game builds or patches at load time come from the phone's DM_NVN_SHDUMP folder copied to <version dir>/shader_dump
